title: I tripled the target on an opening range breakout and it got hit 40 times in 1,056 trades
author: person-person12
selftext:
Ive been going back and forth on reward to risk for an opening range breakout on QQQ, so I ran the same rules three times in [Agenticks](https://www.agenticks.ca/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=autopilot&utm_content=ai_trading) on 5 minute candles from 2020 through the end of 2025, with commission and slippage included. Same entry and same stop every time, the only thing that changed was the target (1:1, 1:2 and 1:3), and anything still open at the close gets flattened.

The headline numbers:

1:1: 54.5% wins, profit factor 0.99, **-2.3%**  
1:2: 48.3% wins, profit factor 1.03, +7.0%  
1:3: 47.7% wins, profit factor 1.04, +10.0%

Max drawdown sat between 22% and 24% on all three.

Tripling the target should have gutted the win rate and it only moved about 7 points, which made no sense to me until I split every trade by how it exited.

At 1:1 the target got hit 466 times, the stop 429 times, and 163 trades were still open at the close.

At 1:3 the target got hit **40 times out of 1,056.** The stop got hit 479 times, and 537 trades, just over half of everything, rode until the session ended. Those close outs made about $218k between them at an 86% win rate, while the 40 target hits made about $49k.

So on almost every day the 1:3 target was too far away to ever be reached, and **the entire improvement over the 1:1 version came from holding winners into the close**, which is an exit rule I never actually wrote down.
